_purpose: Owner risk configuration consumed by app/scripts/preflight.py (approval_exists gate). Presence + zero BLOCK => TRADING READY for ALPACA PAPER ONLY. This file records the owner's WRITTEN authorization for autonomous paper trading under a bounded policy; it does NOT authorize unlimited sizing or live trading.
supersedes: v2 (BTC-only bounded paper; additional pairs + FVG/OB PENDING OWNER APPROVAL).

status.alpaca_paper: APPROVED_BY_OWNER for autonomous paper execution of eligible strategies under the bounded PAPER_AUTONOMOUS policy (owner directive 2026-10-21: explicit authorization for automatic BUY/SELL/HOLD/EXIT on eligible crypto; no per-trade or per-coin approval required).
status.live_trading: NOT APPROVED — forbidden under any circumstances. Requires separate explicit owner approval + clean multi-week live-equivalent reconciliation.
status.additional_pairs: APPROVED_BY_OWNER for PAPER experimental execution (ETH/XRP/DOT/LINK on the daily Z-score as labeled EXPERIMENTAL_PAPER). Enabled only for pairs that pass tradability/data/liquidity/cost/risk gates.
status.usdt: STATUS_ONLY — not traded; requires a demonstrated cost-aware stablecoin strategy first.
status.fvg_ob: RESEARCH_ONLY — 5M/1H sequence cannot be executed inside the single 1D authoritative executor without altering BTC's model; documented as a limitation rather than faked. Relaxed (negative-after-fees) variant stays DISABLED.

scope.executor: single Freqtrade PaperAutonomous dispatcher; no second order executor; the Telegram monitor is read-only.

baseline_strategy_parameters.preserved_by: PaperAutonomous subclasses BtcZScore and delegates the BTC/USD branch to the unchanged parent logic; the BTC math, thresholds, timeframe, and version are not modified.
baseline_strategy_parameters.threshold_status: CANDIDATE defaults, NOT source-verified. The '65.92% CAGR' source claim is NOT reproduced and NOT accepted as fact. Alts reuse the daily Z-score formula as an EXPERIMENT and are NOT assumed profitable from BTC's results.

guardrails: Spot only, long-only, unleveraged; no borrowing, no margin, no shorts, no futures, no leverage.

Autonomous within policy != unrestricted: every entry is validated against per-position, portfolio, exposure, data-freshness, and kill-switch checks; violations are rejected and explained on Telegram.
Never report a trade as FILLED until the broker confirms the fill.
One authoritative order executor; no duplicate orders for the same pair; Z-score and FVG signals must not both open the same pair.
Reconciliation must prove liveness + freshness + broker + identity-reconciled orders; can never report HEALTHY while offline/stale/drifted.
Hard risk limits, broker reconciliation, data-quality checks, and paper-only restriction may NEVER be bypassed to make the bot start or trade.
Live trading stays blocked under any circumstances; the app must never auto-switch to live.
Any new numeric limit, timeframe, pair, or strategy requires a new owner-approved revision of THIS file.
circuit_breaker_recovery: On a 2% daily-equity-loss or 5% peak-to-trough-drawdown breach: block new entries, cancel pending entries where supported, reconcile, follow the tested emergency-exit policy, persist the kill switch, send a CRITICAL Telegram message, and require explicit manual recovery.
remaining_items: Asset-specific backtest for each alt before graduating EXPERIMENTAL_PAPER to a non-experimental label.
FVG/OB executor path if a tested architecture can preserve the exact 5M/1H sequence without changing BTC's model (currently documented as a limitation).
USDT cost-aware strategy research before enabling.
